candidates.label: 009-shortest-word-angle-shifts
candidates.summary: r08-F1-008 leg (Pauli-scheduled q2 block, 16 CX and two 7-T Fredkins per leg) with the r08-F2-008 g free walk end (CZ(g, f) = Z(a) Z(f) while a = f&~g; 9-CX open walk), 83 CX, T_eps 638, plus two depth-only rewrites (depth_CT 1557 -> 1523): every walk rotation is emitted as rz(+-theta + j pi) with j picked for the shortest pygridsynth word (even j = global phase; the odd-j rotations form an even set whose parities XOR to {p_l, p_r, g}, fixed by Z on those idle control wires; the sign of the last 6 rotations is flipped by one x(f) inside the walk, the closing x(f) cancels the z(f) of the g toggle), and negated rccx controls are realised by T/Tdg sign flips instead of X gates (c1: flip r2, r3; c0: flip r1, r2 with Z(t) before, trivial on a clean target, or r3, r4 with Z(t) after, an invariant line phase that commutes with the walk and is dropped).

candidates.label: 009-short-window-fredkin
candidates.summary: r08-F2-008 datapath unchanged in CX (83: parity frame, L: 0 -> ~p_t&~s_r [(1 3) Fredkin] -> g, a: f&~g [(0 2) Fredkin] -> w01, w23, 9-term open R_x walk with free ends {p_r, p_t, p_l, g}) with every Fredkin a 7-CX 7-T word (T_fixed 80 -> 72, T_eps 646 -> 638) chosen from an exhaustive class-BFS enumeration for the shortest control-line window (3 control CX + 1 T, data-only prefix/suffix run beside the neighbouring rccx's), X-free negated rccx controls (T <-> Tdg swaps), free control order on clean-target rccx, Z gates parked in idle control slots, the parity CX(f -> p_r) moved next to the rccx that last reads s_r, and rz(theta) = rz(theta - k pi/2) S^k with k fixed per term for shorter gridsynth words (k = 2 Z's pushed off the f wire through the walk CX's); depth_CT 1560 -> 1522, 11 qubits.

candidates.label: 009-and-toggle-on-pr-wire
candidates.summary: r08-F2-008 datapath (parity frame, L: 0 -> ~p_t&~s_r -> g, a = f&~g, two-swap frame, 9-term R_x walk on f with free ends {p_r, p_t, p_l, g}) with the F1-008 Pauli-scheduled q2 skeleton (7-T Fredkins) and the w23 ancilla removed: inside the H(f) window the w01 AND is toggled onto the p_r wire itself (rccx; p_r holds p_r^w01 between the two toggles, a palindromic phase-permutation of a control wire, so the rccx phases cancel) and w23 onto the a line right after c1 is cleared (fused with the c1 uncompute), and a Dijkstra over (visited terms, f content, toggle phase) gives the same 9-CX walk; negated rccx controls cost no X gates (T signs flipped), the CZ(g,f) free end is folded into the fresh a-compute, and f is the twice-used control of that compute, so depth_CT 1585 -> 1550; 83 CX, T_eps 638, 10 qubits.
